title: Why Should They Stop Expanding? Computational Growth, Tipping Budgets, and the Uniformity Problem
description: CITH v8 research manuscript and reproducibility package. A conditional resource-allocation model of computational growth, tipping budgets, no-replication conditions, infinite-horizon benchmark, risk, latency and population uniformity. Includes PDF and LaTeX manuscripts, mathematical proofs, frozen synthetic inputs, numerical outputs and executable reproduction code. This manuscript is not a peer-reviewed journal publication; it does not establish civilization prevalence, indefinite engineering feasibility or low detectability. Original code is MIT-licensed; original text, figures, documentation and synthetic data are CC BY 4.0. Third-party components retain their existing licenses.
